description: Defines classes and structures related to unit types, animations, attack types, and movement types for the Wesnoth game, including their properties, behaviors, and relationships.

classes.name: unit_animation
classes.description: Represents a sequence of animation frames for a unit, including sound effects.

classes.name: attack_type
classes.description: Defines the properties and behaviors of an attack type, including range, damage, and associated animations.

classes.name: unit_movement_type
classes.description: Describes the movement capabilities and modifiers of a unit, such as flying or land movement.

classes.name: unit_type
classes.description: Encapsulates all properties, behaviors, and variations of a unit type, including graphics, sounds, attacks, and traits.

classes.name: game_data
classes.description: Holds collections of movement types, unit types, and races, representing the overall game configuration.

methods.name: unit_animation::start_animation
methods.description: Starts an animation sequence of a specified type and acceleration.

methods.name: unit_animation::update_current_frames
methods.description: Updates the current frames of the animation based on elapsed time.

methods.name: unit_animation::animation_finished
methods.description: Checks if the current animation sequence has finished.

methods.name: unit_animation::get_current_frame
methods.description: Retrieves the current frame of the animation for a given type.

methods.name: unit_animation::get_animation_time
methods.description: Returns the total duration of the animation.

methods.name: unit_animation::get_first_frame_time
methods.description: Returns the time of the first frame in the animation.

methods.name: unit_animation::get_last_frame_time
methods.description: Returns the time of the last frame in the animation.

methods.name: attack_type::animation
methods.description: Returns a random animation for the attack, possibly based on direction.

methods.name: unit_movement_type::movement_cost
methods.description: Calculates movement cost over a terrain.

methods.name: unit_movement_type::defense_modifier
methods.description: Calculates defense modifier over a terrain.

methods.name: unit_movement_type::damage_against
methods.description: Calculates damage against a specific attack type.

methods.name: unit_movement_type::resistance_against
methods.description: Calculates resistance against a specific attack type.

methods.name: unit_type::generate_description
methods.description: Generates a textual description of the unit type.

methods.name: unit_type::defend_animation
methods.description: Retrieves the defensive animation based on hit/miss and range.

methods.name: unit_type::die_animation
methods.description: Retrieves the death animation for a given attack.
